versions.changelog:
- Initial release of nameplate-attention.
- Displays a topmost message card with pulsating colored borders on every Mac display to grab user attention.
- Always requires a reason for activation; prevents contextless alerts.
- Includes CLI command: `nameplate attention "<reason>" --title "<agent> → <system>"` with optional duration and color.
- Launches Nameplate.app if needed and auto-dismisses alerts after a configurable time (default 10s, max 120s).
- Includes extra commands: `nameplate splash` to replay identity splash, `nameplate settings` to open settings.
- Alerts are timestamped and stale requests (older than 2 minutes) are ignored.
